# Chromatic fresnel rim

Lights the rim of a surface in a full spectrum, violet to red across its width, like dispersive glass or a soap film at grazing angles.

<EffectDemo effect="chromatic-rim" />

## Usage

```ts
import { patchMaterial } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { chromaticRim } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/chromatic-rim';

const effect = chromaticRim({ preset: 'soapFilm' });
patchMaterial(mesh.material, effect);
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => renderer.render(scene, camera));
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.intensity = 1.5`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter   | Type    | Default | Range   | Description                                          |
| ----------- | ------- | ------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `intensity` | number  | `1.5`   | 0 – 8   | Brightness of the rim (HDR above 1).                 |
| `power`     | number  | `2`     | 0.5 – 8 | How tightly the rim hugs the silhouette.             |
| `width`     | number  | `0.6`   | 0.1 – 1 | How far in from the silhouette the spectrum spreads. |
| `reverse`   | boolean | `false` |         | Red on the inside and violet at the silhouette.      |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset     | Settings                                   |
| ---------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| `soapFilm` | `intensity: 1`, `power: 1.5`, `width: 0.9` |
| `crystal`  | `intensity: 2.5`, `power: 3`, `width: 0.4` |
| `neon`     | `intensity: 4`, `power: 2.5`               |
| `reversed` | `reverse: true`                            |

Apply one with `chromaticRim({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Materials · tracked as story X11.8 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Kind:** material effect. `patchMaterial(material, effect)` splices it into MeshBasic, Lambert, Phong, Standard, Physical, Toon and Matcap materials, so lighting, fog and shadows keep working; `unpatchMaterial` removes it. See [material effects](/guide/materials).
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Size:** 6.4 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/chromatic-rim`, including the shared effect runtime.

## Credits

Original implementation (MIT). References: Per-channel Fresnel (Schlick, An inexpensive BRDF model, 1994) with offset powers for a dispersive rim.
